info.name: Publication Quality System API
info.description: Postman-ready API testing collection generated from the current ASP.NET Core controllers. JWT is required for every endpoint except actions explicitly marked AllowAnonymous because the app configures a fallback authenticated-user authorization policy.

JWT required. Policy: FILE_UPLOAD. Multipart/form-data fields: file, type. Type examples: PAPER, PAPER_VERSION, AVATAR, DOCUMENT, TEMP, OTHER. Response DTO: UploadedFileResponse. Test script saves file_id and file_key.
JWT required. Policy: PAPER_VERSION_READ. Generates a presigned download URL for an uploaded file.
JWT required. Policy: FILE_DELETE. Query param: fileKey. Response DTO: BaseResponse<object>.
JWT required. Extracts text from the selected uploaded file by file_id. FE flow: GET /api/files, choose fileId, then call this request.
